description: This file provides configuration helpers for authentication, including retrieval and validation of secrets, salts, and tenant resolution strategies based on environment variables. It defines functions to access secrets like JWT secret, password salt, tenant salt, and tenant configuration, and exports these functions for use in other parts of the application.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes a value by converting undefined or null to empty string and trimming whitespace.

methods.name: isUrlSafeShortBase64
methods.description: Checks if a string is a URL-safe base64-encoded string of appropriate length without padding.

methods.name: getTenantSaltConfig
methods.description: Retrieves and validates the tenant salt from environment variables, normalizing and checking its format.

methods.name: getJwtSecretConfig
methods.description: Retrieves and validates the JWT secret from environment variables, checking for presence and strength.

methods.name: getPasswordSaltConfig
methods.description: Retrieves and validates the password salt from environment variables, checking for placeholder values and length.

methods.name: tenantFromHost
methods.description: Extracts the tenant identifier from a host header by taking the left-most label.

methods.name: getTenantConfig
methods.description: Provides tenant resolution and allowlist/mapping validation based on environment variables and request data.
